title: Reolink Live
gateway.down: The reolink-cli gateway is not running.
ptz.noPresets: No presets yet. Aim the camera and save the position.
presets.full: All preset slots are in use.
empty: No enabled cameras. Enable one under Manage cameras.
hint.ptz: Hold an arrow to move · arrow keys nudge · 1–9 presets · S snapshot · M stream · C camera
hint.basic: S snapshot · M stream · C next camera · R refresh
events.none: No events yet. Motion and detections from every camera show up here.
manage.empty: No cameras registered yet. Search your network or add one by its IP address.
manage.noneFound: No camera answered. Battery cameras only answer while awake, cameras behind a Home Hub or NVR do not answer at all, and a firewall can block the replies. You can still add a camera by its IP address.
manage.name: Name
manage.passwordKeep: Leave empty to keep the current one
manage.passwordNote: The password is checked with a login, then stored encrypted by reolink-cli. Reolink Live never keeps it.
manage.badName: Use 1–64 letters, digits, spaces or . - _ : @ for the name.
manage.badAddress: Enter an IP address or host name (optionally with :port), or a Reolink UID.
manage.badUser: Enter a user name, usually admin.
manage.nameTaken: A camera with this name already exists.
